sources.articleTitle: Breaking: Dead Melbourne Cup runner So You Are found in Sydney skip bin

headline: Melbourne Cup Horse So You Are Discovered In A Sydney Skip Bin
seoTitle: Melbourne Cup Horse Found In Sydney Skip Bin
metaDescription: Following its recent death from colic, the racehorse So You Are, which competed in the Melbourne Cup, was found discarded in a Sydney skip bin.
aiSummaryBullets: The racehorse known as So You Are passed away due to complications from colic.
The animal was a participant in the Melbourne Cup horse racing event.
Reports confirmed the horse was discovered inside a skip bin located in Sydney.
aiContextParagraph: The thoroughbred racehorse So You Are, a known competitor in the Melbourne Cup, has become the focus of a report after being found deceased in a disposal container in Sydney. According to information released on November 17, 2026, the animal died following a medical episode related to colic. This incident has drawn attention due to the high profile of the horse following its participation in Australia's premier racing event. The Melbourne Cup remains a significant cultural and sporting milestone in the nation, drawing national interest. The discovery of the horse in a Sydney skip bin shortly after its death has prompted public inquiry regarding the handling of the animal's remains. There are currently no additional details provided regarding the specific circumstances surrounding the disposal of the horse or any potential investigation into the matter.
